meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 NanoClaw 安装监控仪表盘:复制代码文件、修改入口、配置环境变量,重启后提供本地网页,展示代理组、会话、用户、Token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动与实时日志。
howto.when: 当你要求「给 NanoClaw 加监控仪表盘」「安装 add-dashboard」,或提及配置 DASHBOARD_SECRET、DASHBOARD_PORT 时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘
say.note: 自动安装、接线并重启服务

say.text: 帮我装 add-dashboard 并设置好密钥

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: installs the package, copies pusher files, wires startup into main(), sets env vars, and restarts. Shows agent groups, sessions, users, token use, context windows, message activity, and live logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a dashboard to NanoClaw, install add-dashboard, or configure DASHBOARD_SECRET/DASHBOARD_PORT.

say_en.note: Installs, wires, and restarts the service
